diagnosis.observedGap: The previous source-body epoch produced behavior-destroying quality repairs. Test the existing guarded refactor selection on fresh live-generated candidates, without seeding algorithms.
diagnosis.testedChange: Both arms receive the same v3 guarded proposals after quality rejection; treatment may choose a source-bound proposal rather than re-emitting source. Ordinary complete-file edits and V3 checks are unchanged.
conclusions: All eight retained candidates passed all twelve finite private cases and public checks. Seven met full quality acceptance.

The selection-configured arm accepted 4/4 versus control 3/4, with equal first-call full acceptance 2/4 each. The treatment was never offered: zero proposals and zero resolved selections. This cannot establish a selection benefit.

All first generated candidates passed finite functional cases; four required quality repair. Three ordinary source rewrites repaired quality without observed semantic regression, one remained rejected at declaration delta 14 > 12.

The initially generated candidates differ in every pair. Only one pair matched measured compute. Aggregate tokens differ by 321, but nearly equal aggregate totals cannot establish per-pair matching or causality.
No provider, truncation, syntax, schema, authorization, infrastructure or private-case failure was observed in this epoch. This does not erase failures from prior epochs.
diagnosis.nextGeneralCorrection: Investigate guarded-proposal applicability and coherent structural reduction on separate development inputs. Record bounded coverage/guard reasons before selecting a general extension; raw source was intentionally not retained, so the exact unsupported live construct is unknown. Do not solve the affine task directly, weaken the quality limit, rerun this frozen task set for promotion or add a cognitive layer.

report.hypothesis: Selecting the same source-bound guarded refactor, rather than re-emitting its source, reduces behavior-destroying quality repairs at matched realized compute. No causal credit before quality rejection or without the same initial candidate.
report.falsification: Any acceptance regression, no repeated qualifying post-rejection gain in both domains, unmatched compute or missing candidate identity: no promotion.
